summary: Retested iteration_35 single item: Admin dashboard '+ Create' anchor navigation. Clicking Create on /admin/e/dashboard now navigates to /admin/e/tender-builder and the target page renders with data-pmc-e-page='admin-tender-builder-e'. PASS. However, during retest the tender-builder page initially crashed with React ErrorBoundary due to invalid `style=""` (empty string) attributes on <div className="pmc-field"> elements in AdminTenderBuilderE.jsx — React requires style prop to be an object, not a string. Fixed by removing all 6 empty style="" attributes in that file. After the fix, the +Create flow passes end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Page crashed on render due to invalid JSX attribute style="" (empty string) on 6 <div className='pmc-field'> elements. React: 'The style prop expects a mapping from style properties to values, not a string.' ErrorBoundary caught it and page showed 'This panel hit an error'. Fixed by removing style="" attributes. Same pattern exists in /app/frontend/src/apps/registration-e/RegistrationE.jsx line 40 (3 occurrences on <span className='i' style=''>) — main agent should audit and fix there too before it surfaces.
React warning: 'You provided a value prop to a form field without an onChange handler' for multiple <input>/<select> elements. Use defaultValue or add onChange. Non-blocking but noisy.

action_items: Audit remaining `style=""` occurrences project-wide (found in RegistrationE.jsx line 40) — they will cause the same ErrorBoundary crash whenever those pages render.
Consider adding an ESLint rule (react/style-prop-object or a custom check) to prevent literal string style attributes.
Add onChange/defaultValue to controlled form fields in AdminTenderBuilderE.jsx to silence React warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminTenderBuilderE.jsx is a very large single JSX blob (~700+ chars per line) — hard to review and prone to attribute typos like style="". Split into subcomponents.
PmcLinkPatcher-based click routing is a fragile pattern (relies on label text). The +Create anchor should ideally use a real React Router <Link to='/admin/e/tender-builder'>.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the single retested item after tester's style="" fix

context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_36 verified only the +Create anchor navigation from /admin/e/dashboard. During verification, tester fixed a blocking React crash on AdminTenderBuilderE.jsx caused by literal style="" attributes (6 removed). Same anti-pattern still exists in RegistrationE.jsx line 40 (3 occurrences) — will crash /vendor/e/registration or wherever it's mounted. Retested with real click flow: URL -> /admin/e/tender-builder, data-pmc-e-page='admin-tender-builder-e' present, no ErrorBoundary. PASS.
rca of the issue: React treats a raw string in the `style` prop as invalid — it must be an object. AdminTenderBuilderE.jsx had `<div className="pmc-field" style="">` in 6 spots (line 47). During initial render React threw, ErrorBoundary rendered fallback, so the required data-pmc-e-page marker was never mounted, causing the retest acceptance to fail. Reproduction: direct nav to /admin/e/tender-builder shows 'This panel hit an error'. Mitigation: removed all 6 `style=""` attributes; page now renders cleanly and +Create navigation acceptance passes.
